verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-product AI that analyzes user data and gives suggestions. Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence for relevance, scope and timeliness, and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots so you can fix them before the audit. It also offers AI-assisted due diligence reviews. These are narrow, feature-specific uses rather than broad AI insights across the user's compliance data, and none is corroborated hands-on. Missing for 10: general AI insights or recommendations across dashboards and posture data, a conversational assistant over customer data, detail on the depth of AI-assisted due diligence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
